response.title: which power station runs a tent air conditioner the longest
response.answer:
For running a tent air conditioner as long as possible, the most important specification is the power station's battery capacity (Wh), not its maximum output wattage.

My recommendation is to look at large expandable power stations from EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, Jackery, and BLUETTI.

A typical tent air conditioner consumes roughly 200–700 watts, depending on its size, cooling technology, and operating conditions.

| 10,000 Wh | 42.5 hours | 17 hours |

Actual runtimes depend on compressor cycling, outdoor temperature, and inverter losses.
